# B2 — Time, grind, estimates (evidence reader, side-session 2026-10-03)

Question (BRIEFS.md §B2): what the record shows about (a) long computations and whether a better tool or algorithm replaced grinding; (b) estimates made in advance against actuals; (c) work the record calls wasted; (d) deaths at usage or output limits.

## Plan (status: done 2026-10-03)

1. List the LOG.md session headings (`^## `), cut to 400 chars, for Table 5 (Sessions 19–41: wall time, context %, agents, tokens).
2. grep LOG.md for "Spent for nothing" (Table 3) and for death/wall patterns (`usage|128k|ceiling|died|relaunch|sleep`) (Table 4).
3. grep LOG.md and STATUS.md l. 401+ for long-leg patterns (`h wall|hours| min|wall`), then the named compute folders (d1-m2a, d1-m3, c2-m2/campaign, free-greedy-s40/compute, lemmaB-s41/U7-patterns) for wall times and speed-ups (`speed-?up|faster|rewrote|vectoriz|ported to C|Colab|T4|GPU`) (Table 1).
4. grep for advance estimates (`estimate|priced|feasib|overstated|understated|slots|tokens`) and pair only with actuals the record states (Table 2).
5. Collect run minutes and tokens per agent kind where entries record them ("Counts and medians").
6. Append each table in batches of at most five rows; a dated SHARED.md block after each batch.
7. Final section: what could not be checked.

Citations: file and line, verbatim quotes of at most about 40 words; "not found in <scope, patterns>" where nothing was found.

## What could not be checked, and scope limits

- LOG.md was 2317 lines at this read (BRIEFS.md says 2309); line numbers above are for the 2317-line file. The side-session heading at l. 2311 is outside Sessions 19–41.
- Session 9 has no LOG.md entry (headings jump from l. 277, Session 8, to l. 297, Session 10); the cause of its two lost deliverables (Table 4 row 5) is not stated at l. 297–300.
- Sessions 40 and 41: no duration is stated in the closing headings (only opening and closing clock times); none is computed here.
- Minutes for several Session 39–41 units (fejer-form, dz-half, u-offsurgery, qtwin, lemmaG; lemmaB-s41 U1–U7) were not found in the harvest lines by the patterns used (`≈ Nk, N min`, `N min)`), so the Session 36–41 minute medians rest on n = 8 writers and n = 9 readers.
- Sessions 1–17 agent workflows (sweeps, verification workflows, e.g. LOG l. 109 "~2.1M tokens", l. 1217 "≈ 25 M tokens across ~70 agents", l. 1418 "13 agents, 2.81M tokens, 144 min") are agent-reasoning legs, not compute legs, and are not tabulated in Table 1 or in the medians.
- STATUS.md l. 401–635 and `directions/*.md` were read by pattern search, not line by line. `results/d1-m3/` (README.md, LEDGER.md) has no wall-time or speed-up figure (patterns `wall|min|hours|h|speed|faster|estimate|cost`); its README l. 13 says the cost of shallow boxes "must be priced before M3 is funded".
- Table 1 row 8 (the Session 14 Lean check, "~1–2 h wall") has no recorded actual in l. 759–775.
- The GPU port's absence after Session 25 rests on a search of LOG.md l. 1706–2317 and `directions/*.md` for `GPU|Colab|cuda|numba`; other files were not searched for it.
- Rehearsal status is recorded per leg only where a NOTE, brief or STATUS line names it; the KICKSTART rule text is `KICKSTART.md` l. 80, "any computational leg or Lean build longer than one session slot first runs end-to-end on a smaller instance of the same shape".
